claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition
claims.evidence: Single static photo shows only exterior; no power-on or stitching test visible.
Front panel text noted as too small/unclear to read with confidence; no brand identified by witness.
No video or audio clip of machine running; photo is static.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: Photo shows only the machine and pedal; no bobbins, needles, manual, or extra cables visible.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service record, receipt, or internal view provided; unverifiable claim about history.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly
risks.proof: Video clip of machine plugged in, pedal pressed, needle moving and stitching a test fabric swatch
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: Hidden internal wear, rust, or belt/motor damage not visible from front angle
risks.proof: Photos of underside, bobbin case, and interior with cover removed

risks.risk: Missing accessories (manual, extra bobbins, foot attachments, power cable condition)
risks.proof: Photo laying out all included accessories next to the machine

risks.risk: Unknown age/model may affect parts availability and value
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of brand/model nameplate or serial number
Close-up photo of pedal cord and plug condition

proof_requests: Close-up clear photo of the brand/model nameplate on the front panel
Video of the machine powering on and stitching a sample fabric
Photo of all included accessories (manual, bobbins, needles, cables) laid out together
Photo of the underside/interior showing belt and motor condition
Photo of the power cord and pedal plug for wear/damage
response.reason: The witness clearly identified the item as a sewing machine by type, so it can be priced at worst case (functionality and accessories unverified) pending the requested proof.
